hooks.command: sqlite3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tasks.db" "SELECT printf('roadmap · %d/%d done · %d active · %d pending · blockers %d unresolved · action items %d/%d (P0 %d/%d)', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roadmap_items WHERE status='completed'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roadmap_items), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roadmap_items WHERE status='in_progress'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roadmap_items WHERE status='pending'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blockers WHERE resolved_at IS NULL), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_items WHERE status='completed'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_items), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_items WHERE priority='P0' AND status='completed'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_items WHERE priority='P0'));" 2>/dev/null || true
